_about: Settings of the reviewed-first check (rule 10). Where the reviews are kept, which connectors are part of the app itself, and the few packages that may be run without a review. This file cannot switch the check off: that needs the person's own words in their own message.
_catalogue: The connector catalogue. Only its bold verdict lines and its '## Review:' sections are read.
_handSources: Where a connector's definition came from, as Claude Code gives it (mcp_server.source), for servers written into a settings file by hand. For these the app-name list and the long-id rule below are not trusted: the registry must clear them.
_claudeaiIsDirectory: A connector whose source is 'claudeai' was added in claude.ai, where the directory lives; rule 10 says directory connectors need no review. Set false to make even these need a registry entry.
_grandfather: Tools already in use before reviews began (registry state active or installed-unused, with an empty review, from a source other than third-party) count as cleared. A third-party tool never does.
_builtIn: Connector servers that are part of the Claude app itself, not outside tools. A name ending in * matches every server that starts with it.
_directoryIds: Connectors added from the claude.ai directory show up under an id shaped like 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003 (a made-up one); rule 10 says directory connectors are fine. A custom connector added by hand in claude.ai has the same shape, which this check cannot tell apart.
_trustedRun: Packages that may be run with npx, dlx, bunx or uvx without a review, because the notebook's own steps run them. Each needs a reason.
_shellScripts: Web addresses whose script may be piped into a shell. Empty: piping a downloaded script into a shell is always refused, because no review can see what it will run.
